json_proto.name: MARIO_TELEMETRY

queries.sqlText: SELECT EVENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS EVENT_COUNT FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.GAME_EVENTS_LIVE GROUP BY EVENT_TYPE ORDER BY EVENT_COUNT DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: How many events are there for each event type?

queries.sqlText: SELECT LEVEL, DEATHS FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.DEATHS_BY_LEVEL_LIVE ORDER BY DEATHS DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which level has the most deaths?

queries.sqlText: SELECT KEY_NAME, PRESSES FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.KEY_PRESSES_LIVE ORDER BY PRESSES DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the most pressed key?

queries.sqlText: SELECT POWERUP_TYPE, SUM(COUNT) AS TOTAL FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.POWERUPS_LIVE GROUP BY POWERUP_TYPE ORDER BY TOTAL DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: What are the most collected powerup types?

queries.sqlText: SELECT SESSION_ID, MAX_COINS, HIGHEST_LEVEL, DEATHS, LEVELS_WON, COINS_COLLECTED FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.PLAYER_SESSIONS_LIVE ORDER BY COINS_COLLECTED DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: Show me the player session with the most coins collected

queries.sqlText: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', TIMESTAMP) AS HOUR, COUNT(*) AS EVENTS FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.GAME_EVENTS_LIVE GROUP BY HOUR ORDER BY HOUR
queries.correspondingQuestion: How many game events occurred per hour?

queries.sqlText: SELECT EVENT_TYPE, MINUTE, EVENT_COUNT FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.EVENT_TIMELINE_LIVE ORDER BY MINUTE DESC LIMIT 20
queries.correspondingQuestion: Show the most recent event timeline

queries.sqlText: SELECT LEVEL, POWERUP_TYPE, COUNT FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.POWERUPS_LIVE ORDER BY LEVEL, COUNT DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: What powerups were collected on each level?

queries.sqlText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_EVENTS, COUNT(DISTINCT SESSION_ID) AS UNIQUE_SESSIONS, COUNT(DISTINCT EVENT_TYPE) AS EVENT_TYPES FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.GAME_EVENTS_LIVE
queries.correspondingQuestion: Give me an overview of total events, sessions, and event types

queries.sqlText: SELECT SESSION_ID, DEATHS, LEVELS_WON, COINS_COLLECTED, TIMEDIFF('MINUTE', SESSION_START, SESSION_END) AS DURATION_MINUTES FROM DIS_MARIO.PUBLIC.PLAYER_SESSIONS_LIVE
queries.correspondingQuestion: How long did each session last and what was achieved?

json_proto.semanticDescription: Telemetry analytics model for Super Mario Bros game running on Snowpark Container Services (SPCS). Tracks real-time game events, player sessions, deaths by level, key presses, powerup collection, and event timelines collected via OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
